top.zh:
纽约巴克莱中心，穹顶之下，万籁将寂。

大屏幕猩红如血，映出“2-0”二字，刺目非常。T1已握赛点，第七冠触手可及。看台上，Faker的传说如潮水般传唱，声浪翻涌，几欲掀翻这钢铁穹顶。

369独坐台前，右手止不住地颤。掌中那枚能量原石，曾映照过LPL的万千荣光，此刻却黯淡如死灰。他心中喟叹：“难道，便止步于此了么？”

话音未落，原石忽而剧震，“嗖”地一声破空而去，竟自场馆缝隙中穿梭而出，没入纽约的夜雨之中。

场外细雨如丝，冷风萧瑟。一瘦弱少年，负双肩包，独立雨幕之下。那原石恰入其怀，竟缓缓融于其身。倏忽间，少年背后虚空裂开，现出一道璀璨圆环——

圆环之中，TheShy剑魔一剑劈开天地，Bin武器大师反制乾坤，Letme奥恩熔铸山河，扣肉纳尔巨化擎天，Gogoing流浪法师步法如风。五道身影，五色光华，冲天而起，直贯云霄。LPL十余载沉浮，不屈之魂尽凝于此，其声震耳，响彻寰宇。

少年抹去脸上雨痕，嘴角微扬，轻声道：

“游戏，才刚刚开始。”

——雨未歇，剑已鸣。
top.en: New York Barclay's Center, under the dome, all is quiet. The giant screen glows blood-red, displaying a glaring "2-0". T1 already holds match point, their seventh title within reach. In the stands, Faker's legend echoes like a tidal wave, the roaring sound threatening to blow off this steel dome. 369 sits alone at the front, his right hand trembling uncontrollably. The primordial energy stone in his palm once reflected the countless glories of the LPL, but now it is as dim as dead ash. He sighs inwardly: "Could it be that it ends here?" Before his voice fades, the stone suddenly vibrates violently, shooting out with a sonic boom, piercing through a gap in the arena and vanishing into the rainy New York night. Outside, the fine rain falls like silk, the cold wind desolate. A thin youth, carrying a backpack, stands alone in the curtain of rain. The stone falls right into his embrace, slowly melting into his body. Suddenly, the void behind the youth cracks open, revealing a dazzling ring— Within the ring, Flandre's Aatrox splits heaven and earth with a single slash, Bin's Jax turns the tables on the cosmos, Letme's Ornn forges rivers and mountains, Clearlove's Gnar grows giant to prop up the heavens, Gogoing's Ryze moves as swift as the wind. Five figures, five colors of brilliance, shoot straight up into the clouds. Over a decade of ups and downs in the LPL, the unyielding souls condense right here, their roar deafening, echoing through the universe. The youth wipes the rain from his face, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly, whispering softly: "The game has only just begun." ——The rain hasn't stopped, the sword already rings.
